library.pt_200:r_f90c529773d5c0fc.text:
$$甲児$$'s younger brother.
An energetic, cheerful elementary school student whose motto is not to think too deeply about anything.
Though he adores his grandfather Juzo, his childish bluntness often gets the better of him, and he frequently cracks jokes like calling his grandfather's face scary, for which $$甲児$$ would scold him each time.
Meeting the mysterious girl $$ローレライ$$ draws him into the secrets of the Kabuto family.

library.pt_200:r_6f852856a05f2856.text:
$$甲児$$'s younger brother.
An energetic, cheerful elementary school student whose motto is not to think too deeply about anything.
Though he adores his grandfather Juzo, his childish bluntness often gets the better of him, and he frequently cracks jokes like calling his grandfather's face scary, for which $$甲児$$ would scold him each time.
Meeting the mysterious girl $$ローレライ$$ draws him into the secrets of the Kabuto family, and for a time he joined $$甲児$$ in rejecting their mother $$つばさ$$. However, when $$つばさ$$ grew weak under Pygman's curse, he served as her bodyguard on $$甲児$$'s orders and was eventually able to reconcile with her.

library.pt_200:r_344b999e99fce9aa.text:
Director of the Photon Power Institute.
He once studied under $$甲児$$'s grandfather, Juzo Kabuto, and worked together with him researching photon power.
Even after Juzo disappeared, he continued research toward practical application, holding to the belief that photon power must be used for peace.
In the final battle, faced with the fierce onslaught of Viscount Pygman and his army of Mechanical Beasts, he made the agonizing decision to activate the Scientific Fortress Institute, which actively employed photon energy in combat.

library.pt_200:r_52f25e9d583892b3.text:
One of the Three Doctors of the Photon Power Institute, and an authority on robotics.
True to his energetic-sounding name, he is a vigorous, high-energy person.
All three doctors are old friends of Juzo's and call him 'Juzo-chan.'

library.pt_200:r_ae2cd11c2a0090ad.text:
One of the Three Doctors of the Photon Power Institute, and an authority on robotics.
His name gives a slow-moving impression, but his mind works quickly.
Together with the other two doctors, he has developed robots for the Mazinger corps, including Million Alpha, Baion Beta, and Daion Gamma.

library.pt_200:r_0867c3309659e557.text:
One of the Three Doctors of the Photon Power Institute, and an authority on robotics.
Together with $$のっそり$$ and $$もりもり$$, he built the Jet Scrander.
All three doctors are quite lecherous, and they idolize $$菊ノ助$$ of the $$くろがね屋$$.

library.pt_200:r_b28d68ba1590745b.text:
Proprietress of the $$くろがね屋$$, a hot spring inn in Atami.
A mysterious figure who commands the eccentric Kurogane Five and runs the $$くろがね屋$$.
She once served as an assistant to Dr. Hell as a biologist, and accompanied him on the survey of Bardos Island. There she met Kenzo Kabuto, whom she later married, and the two had $$甲児$$ and $$シロー$$ together. Before marrying Kenzo, she had also once been engaged to Stroheim Heinrich, an authority on robotics just like Kenzo.
While surveying Bardos Island, she noticed Dr. Hell's scheme and tried to stop it together with Juzo and the others, but the attempt failed when she was betrayed by Kenzo, whose body had been taken over by Kedora. Even so, she managed to escape and waited for a chance to strike back.
Once $$マジンガーＺ$$, the trump card against Dr. Hell, passed into $$甲児$$'s hands, she supported him in many ways, helping him grow.

library.pt_200:r_77c9febbf92c6791.text:
Proprietress of the $$くろがね屋$$, a hot spring inn in Atami.
A mysterious figure who commands the eccentric Kurogane Five and runs the $$くろがね屋$$.
She once served as an assistant to Dr. Hell as a biologist, and accompanied him on the survey of Bardos Island. There she met Kenzo Kabuto, whom she later married, and the two had $$甲児$$ and $$シロー$$ together. Before marrying Kenzo, she had also once been engaged to Stroheim Heinrich, an authority on robotics just like Kenzo.
While surveying Bardos Island, she noticed Dr. Hell's scheme and tried to stop it together with Juzo and the others, but the attempt failed when she was betrayed by Kenzo, whose body had been taken over by Kedora. Even so, she managed to escape and waited for a chance to strike back.
Once $$マジンガーＺ$$, the trump card against Dr. Hell, passed into $$甲児$$'s hands, she supported him in many ways, helping him grow.
In the final battle, upon learning that her husband Kenzo, whom she had once believed she had killed, was still alive, she infiltrated enemy territory carrying a photon bomb, intending to finish him off for good this time. However, Kenzo had regained his sanity, and hearing the truth from him, she learned of the fatal mistake she had made.

library.pt_200:r_df16e85fa9863eff.text:
One of the Kurogane Five, known as 'An the Weasel.'
He works as the bath attendant at the $$くろがね屋$$, scrubbing guests' backs, but is in truth a bomb specialist.
He has a photon bomb embedded in his own body, and is a fearless man always ready to blow himself up at a moment's notice.
He seems to get along well with $$暗黒寺$$ and $$シロー$$, and the three of them were often seen acting together.

library.pt_200:r_925e934a0ef2b316.text:
Head clerk of the $$くろがね屋$$ and one of the Kurogane Five.
He also serves as the leader of the Five, and is deeply trusted by the proprietress $$つばさ$$.
A cyborg with a head and arms made of Chogokin Z, boasting monstrous strength to rival even a Mechanical Beast.

library.pt_200:r_6dd3d3bb3f00b3fe.text:
One of the Kurogane Five.
A swordmaster whose real name is unknown, he can cleave through anything with his Japanese sword made of Chogokin Z.
He seems to be skilled with blades of all kinds, and his knife work is second to none. Normally he plies his trade as the head chef of the $$くろがね屋$$.
He takes great pride in his work as a chef, and there was even a moment when he showed open anger after the $$ガミアＱ$$ ruined one of his dishes.

library.pt_200:r_2d281d6864c71aac.text:
One of the Kurogane Five.
He works as the $$くろがね屋$$'s driver, but his main role is cleaning up the gangsters who gather from all over the country to target them.
His beloved gun, the Super Blackhawk .44 Magnum, can fire up to six rounds of Chogokin Z ammunition. He has also used a freeze rifle to slow down a Mechanical Beast, displaying gunslinging skills befitting his cowboy style.

library.pt_200:r_270dc537fe40c607.text:
One of the Kurogane Five.
She normally serves as the head maid of the $$くろがね屋$$, and looks like an unremarkable old woman, but she is the strongest of the Five in actual skill. Even $$つばさ$$ holds her in high regard, calling her 'Big Sister $$お菊$$.'
Her weapon of choice is a wire made of Chogokin Z, and her movements are extraordinary; even when $$甲児$$, who had overwhelmed $$ボス$$ in a fight, challenged her with all his strength, he could not lay a single finger on her.

library.pt_200:r_f7408752acf35362.text:
A blonde, blue-eyed girl, daughter of Stroheim Heinrich.
She suddenly appeared at the $$くろがね屋$$ one day and grew close to $$シロー$$.
Her true identity is the brain of Donau Alpha 1, and her becoming friends with $$シロー$$ was orchestrated by Stroheim, who was trying to teach her the emotion of sadness.
However, Stroheim died trying to reclaim Donau Alpha 1 after it was seized by $$あしゅら男爵$$. Upon losing her beloved father, $$ローレライ$$ came to know the emotion of sadness, and pulled out the ribbon on her head, the device that let her merge, becoming one with Donau Alpha 1. She then went into battle to fulfill her father's wish of defeating $$マジンガーＺ$$.

library.pt_200:r_7859c3c3de9bb998.text:
A blonde, blue-eyed girl, daughter of Stroheim Heinrich.
She suddenly appeared at the $$くろがね屋$$ one day and grew close to $$シロー$$.
Her true identity is the brain of Donau Alpha 1, and her becoming friends with $$シロー$$ was orchestrated by Stroheim, who was trying to teach her the emotion of sadness.
However, Stroheim died trying to reclaim Donau Alpha 1 after it was seized by $$あしゅら男爵$$. Upon losing her beloved father, $$ローレライ$$ came to know the emotion of sadness, and pulled out the ribbon on her head, the device that let her merge, becoming one with Donau Alpha 1. She then went into battle to fulfill her father's wish of defeating $$マジンガーＺ$$.
She fought $$マジンガーＺ$$ on more than equal terms, but was ultimately defeated. As $$シロー$$'s anguished cries echoed around her, the broken machinery of Donau kept sounding on, sad and mournful, as if it were $$ローレライ$$'s own song.

library.pt_200:r_4e271c7cfac7c6d8.text:
A delinquent detective working at the Atami Police Station.
Ordered to guard Juzo, he was investigating the string of incidents occurring around the $$くろがね屋$$. In the process, he got caught up in the battle between $$マジンガーＺ$$ and a Mechanical Beast led by $$あしゅら$$, and continued to act alongside $$甲児$$ and the others from then on.
He is basically flippant and a bit of a loudmouth. He is also quite the ladies' man, and once even peeped on a bathing $$ガミアＱ$$ together with $$シロー$$ and An.

library.pt_200:r_d3f45c4542bb47f4.text:
A delinquent detective working at the Atami Police Station.
Ordered to guard Juzo, he was investigating the string of incidents occurring around the $$くろがね屋$$. In the process, he got caught up in the battle between $$マジンガーＺ$$ and a Mechanical Beast led by $$あしゅら$$, and continued to act alongside $$甲児$$ and the others from then on.
He is basically flippant and a bit of a loudmouth. He is also quite the ladies' man, and once even peeped on a bathing $$ガミアＱ$$ together with $$シロー$$ and An.
In the final battle, he moved on someone's orders and saved the Photon Power Institute from a crisis, but he could not prevent the worst-case scenario that Dr. Hell had feared.

library.pt_200:r_df2441e5fd1c9390.text:
A female-type android developed for combat. Five units exist, numbered Q1 through Q5.
In addition to high physical ability, their long, freely extending hair has extraordinary cutting power, ruthlessly slicing apart any target.
They say only what is necessary and remain permanently expressionless. Even so, their inhumanly beautiful looks captivated many men, $$暗黒寺$$ among them.

library.pt_200:r_233413d64a87f725.text:
A female-type android developed for combat. Five units exist, numbered Q1 through Q5.
In addition to high physical ability, their long, freely extending hair has extraordinary cutting power, ruthlessly slicing apart any target.
They say only what is necessary and remain permanently expressionless. Even so, their inhumanly beautiful looks captivated many men, $$暗黒寺$$ among them.
After battling $$甲児$$ and the others, most of them were destroyed, but Q3, which had suffered the least damage, was repaired and began acting alongside $$暗黒寺$$. In the final battle against Dr. Hell, she used a secretly installed function for controlling photon energy to thwart Dr. Hell's plan to seize it.

library.pt_200:r_1d6eea4e51c81aac.text:
A cyborg under Dr. Hell's command, and commander of the $$あしゅら$$ Legion, one of the Five Great Legions.
Originally a man and woman who had been sleeping on Bardos Island, he was revived when Dr. Hell and his men fused their bodies together. At that time, he was rigged so that an electric current would run through his body if he ever tried to take $$錦織つばさ$$'s life.
Wielding the Bardos Staff, he freely commands Mechanical Beasts, and has fought fierce battles against $$甲児$$ piloting $$マジンガーＺ$$.
Even unarmed, he boasts high combat ability, and a single blow from him carries enough force to stagger $$マジンガーＺ$$.

library.pt_200:r_eabd4c855c146340.text:
A cyborg under Dr. Hell's command, and commander of the $$あしゅら$$ Legion, one of the Five Great Legions.
Wielding the Bardos Staff, he freely commands Mechanical Beasts, and has fought fierce battles against $$甲児$$ piloting $$マジンガーＺ$$.
Even unarmed, he boasts high combat ability, and a single blow from him carries enough force to stagger $$マジンガーＺ$$.
He was originally Tristan and Isolde, priests of ancient Mycenae who had been sleeping on Bardos Island, but through Dr. Hell's scheme each lost half of their body. The two halves were fused together to make up for what was lost, and he was reborn as $$あしゅら男爵$$. At that time he was placed under a hypnotic suggestion preventing him from defying his master Dr. Hell or $$錦織つばさ$$, who performed the revival surgery.
There was also a second suggestion: as long as Dr. Hell lives, $$あしゅら男爵$$ cannot take his own life.
Though he had sworn absolute loyalty to Dr. Hell as the master who had revived him, upon learning through a vision shown by Kedora that it was Dr. Hell himself who had caused him to lose half his body, he resolved to rebel. In the final battle he joined forces with $$甲児$$ and $$つばさ$$ to bring about Dr. Hell's defeat.
But $$あしゅら男爵$$'s true aim was to break Dr. Hell's hypnotic hold and take his own life. This would revive the Gods of Mycenae, bringing the world to its worst possible fate.

library.pt_200:r_6ac16dd1b88d8837.text:
A cyborg under Dr. Hell's command, and commander of the Iron $$クロス$$ Legion, one of the Five Great Legions.
He was originally a legendary soldier feared for his mastery of ruthless strategy, revived through Dr. Hell's bio-revival technology. His head is detachable, and he can move his body even with his head removed.
In contrast to $$あしゅら男爵$$, who tends to rely on brute force, he prefers strategies built on cunning.
He also commands the flying fortress Ghoul, and his legion includes numerous flying-type Mechanical Beasts.

library.pt_200:r_c5ac17bc7a26b38b.text:
A cyborg under Dr. Hell's command, and commander of the Iron $$クロス$$ Legion, one of the Five Great Legions.
He was originally a legendary soldier feared for his mastery of ruthless strategy, revived through Dr. Hell's bio-revival technology. His head is detachable, and he can move his body even with his head removed.
In contrast to $$あしゅら男爵$$, who tends to rely on brute force, he prefers strategies built on cunning.
He also commands the flying fortress Ghoul, and his legion includes numerous flying-type Mechanical Beasts.
In the final battle, he sortied himself with only his head mounted in the Mechanical Beast $$ブロッケン$$ V2 Schneider. He cornered $$ビューナスＡ$$, but when he tried to force himself on her indecently, he incurred $$弓$$'s wrath and was annihilated by a photon cannon blast from the Scientific Fortress Institute.

library.pt_200:r_6fa61627aca9fc20.text:
One of the Three Great Gods of Mycenae, a god among gods.
In ancient times, he rose in rebellion to protect humanity from the Gods of Mycenae.
In battle, the armor covering his body shines gold. The weapon in his hand is ever-changing, usually a sword but at times shifting into a spear, and the letter 'Z' is carved into both the sword and his forehead.
$$甲児$$, $$つばさ$$, and $$あしゅら男爵$$ encountered him after being sent into ancient Mycenae, the world within Kedora's memories.

library.pt_200:r_dd5772179cd70a1e.text:
One of the Three Great Gods of Mycenae, a god among gods.
In ancient times, he rose in rebellion to protect humanity from the Gods of Mycenae.
In battle, the armor covering his body shines gold. The weapon in his hand is ever-changing, usually a sword but at times shifting into a spear, and the letter 'Z' is carved into both the sword and his forehead.
$$甲児$$, $$つばさ$$, and $$あしゅら男爵$$ encountered him after being sent into ancient Mycenae, the world within Kedora's memories.
Caught off guard by a scheme, he had his right arm severed by Hades, but drove Hades off by fighting alongside $$マジンガーＺ$$. His severed right arm turned into Japanium ore, and was left beneath Bardos Island as the source of Chogokin Z and photon energy.

library.pt_200:r_8942f4525f787535.text:
One of the Three Great Gods of Mycenae.
Known by the names 'King of Hell' and 'King of the Underworld,' he rules the land of the dead.
He wields the power of fire, fighting with a pair of great swords wreathed in crimson flame.
$$甲児$$, $$つばさ$$, and $$あしゅら男爵$$ encountered him after being sent into ancient Mycenae, the world within Kedora's memories.

library.pt_200:r_3efbfdbfd6922e4b.text:
One of the Three Great Gods of Mycenae.
Known by the names 'King of Hell' and 'King of the Underworld,' he rules the land of the dead.
He wields the power of fire, fighting with a pair of great swords wreathed in crimson flame.
$$甲児$$, $$つばさ$$, and $$あしゅら男爵$$ encountered him after being sent into ancient Mycenae, the world within Kedora's memories.
He schemed with Grand Duke Gorgon to do away with Zeus, another of the Three Great Gods of Mycenae, but was defeated when $$マジンガーＺ$$ appeared and joined forces with Zeus. At the moment of his death, however, he vowed to return as the Emperor of Darkness, and vanished into the flames.

library.pt_200:r_386437770208780d.text:
A machine god of Mycenae.
He is called 'the $$ブレイヴ$$' for his valor.
After many long years, his body was split into the two Mechanical Beasts $$ガラダＫ７$$ and Dublas M2.
$$甲児$$, $$つばさ$$, and $$あしゅら男爵$$ encountered him after being sent into ancient Mycenae, the world within Kedora's memories.
Unlike an ordinary Mechanical Beast, he has a will of his own and is even able to speak.

library.pt_200:r_e9bf29b94748e33a.text:
A machine god of Mycenae.
He is called 'the $$ブレイヴ$$' for his valor.
After many long years, his body was split into the two Mechanical Beasts $$ガラダＫ７$$ and Dublas M2.
$$甲児$$, $$つばさ$$, and $$あしゅら男爵$$ encountered him after being sent into ancient Mycenae, the world within Kedora's memories. He fought $$マジンガーＺ$$ and was defeated by the Rust Hurricane.
Unlike an ordinary Mechanical Beast, he has a will of his own and is even able to speak.

library.pt_200:r_1cc37dcb1f5b223a.text:
Main pilot of $$ダイ・ガード$$. 25 years old.
He belongs to Public Relations Section 2 of the Planning and Development Department at $$２１世紀警備保障$$, where he normally handles desk work and PR activities at events. But the moment a $$ヘテロダイン$$ appears, he boards $$ダイ・ガード$$ and goes into battle to build a peaceful future and protect everyone's happiness.
Ask him what he likes and he will answer 'giant robots!' without hesitation, that is how much he loves them. As a child, watching hero shows on television, he declared he would definitely become a pilot, and he grew up never losing that boyish heart.
In time he entered the International Defense University (National Defense University), attached to the Far East Command of the $$ＵＮ$$ Security Force, and earned his Class A license for upright heavy machinery. On the recommendation of his cousin $$神村$$, secretary to the president of $$２１世紀警備保障$$, he joined his current company for the sake of piloting $$ダイ・ガード$$.
He is cheerful, lively, and full of emotion, always the one lifting spirits in the section. His strength lies in his overflowing sense of justice, helping the weak and standing up to the strong, and many people have been moved by his passion. That said, he also tends to get more fired up than necessary, and it is just as true that he often does something reckless and gets scolded for it.
He dislikes green peppers and celery, and retains a childish streak in various ways. His hobbies are jogging to stay in shape and, fittingly for a robot lover, building plastic models. $$いぶき$$ has also mentioned that he buys up huge quantities of toys besides.

library.pt_200:r_2cc2e7a8d00258a8.text:
Navigator of $$ダイ・ガード$$. 20 years old.
She is younger than Akagi and $$青山$$, but since she joined the company right after graduating high school, she is technically their senior. In fact, she is capable both as an office worker and as a navigator, and with her strong-willed, tomboyish personality, neither Akagi nor $$青山$$ can get the better of her.
In the past, she lost her beloved real father in an incident involving a $$ヘテロダイン$$, and her mother remarried another man, a doctor. She constantly argues with her stepfather over their differing ways of thinking.
At first, she had not fully overcome the wound of losing her father, and harbored an extraordinary hatred toward the $$ヘテロダイン$$. That was why, like Akagi, she had joined the company hoping to pilot $$ダイ・ガード$$, and her intense desire to avenge her father sometimes led her to act even more recklessly than he did.
As the fighting continued, a $$ヘテロダイン$$ (of the same type) that had caused her real father's death appeared. Losing her composure disrupted her navigation, causing Akagi and $$青山$$ to be injured, and she lost her confidence. She was further shocked when $$百目鬼$$, a scientist like her father, confronted her with the true meaning behind her father's actions, and in her despair she even tried to quit the company for a time. However, through teamwork with Akagi and the others she found herself again, and from then on she was able to face the $$ヘテロダイン$$ in her duties with a more honest heart.

library.pt_200:r_651717fdaf688e9b.text:
Engineer of $$ダイ・ガード$$. 25 years old.
After graduating from Hokkaido General Institute of Technology, he joined $$２１世紀警備保障$$. He entered the same section as Akagi in the same year, but their personalities are polar opposites. As an engineer he has real skill, handling the control and management of $$ダイ・ガード$$'s various systems and drive units flawlessly. However, he seems to have had no interest at all in being an active pilot; his stated motive for joining was that it looked like 'a reasonably relaxed, well-paying, high-profile job.'
At first he showed reluctance to fight the $$ヘテロダイン$$ and even submitted his resignation. But in the end he could not leave his comrades behind and came back, showing that underneath he has a warm, soft-hearted nature.
In his day-to-day work he has a laid-back, individualistic streak, and used to leave for home alone while everyone else worked overtime, which could look self-centered. But this was actually so he could visit his hospitalized mother, revealing both an admirable reluctance to explain himself and a devotion to family.
Good-looking, tall (180 cm), athletic, financially stable, a smooth talker, a strong drinker, and a skilled driver, he possesses nearly every quality that could attract women. In fact, he is quite popular with women both inside and outside the company, and $$中原$$ from the same section has feelings for him too, though at present he does not appear to have a girlfriend.

library.pt_200:r_de162533342e3449.text:
Main pilot of Kokubouger.
He was Akagi's mentor back in his National Defense University days, serving as a practical skills instructor. Since Akagi's student days he has called him 'Akaten' (failing grade), and even now treats him as if he were still his underachieving student.
Being older, he shows no flashiness, but his skill, backed by experience, is genuine. He has repeatedly demonstrated high ability in many respects: always calm and precise judgment, the insight to notice Akagi's poor physical condition when even $$いぶき$$ and $$青山$$ had not, and the leadership to keep Kokubouger's two sub-pilots in line.
He basically follows orders from his superiors faithfully, but he is a man of sound conscience who can put human life first. When Kokubouger was engulfed by a $$ヘテロダイン$$, he had his two sub-pilots evacuate at his own risk, fully aware he was disobeying orders. He also objected to a superior officer who wanted to use an OE weapon with $$ヘテロダイン$$ annihilation as the top priority, showing his deeply human side time and again.

library.pt_200:r_07308223fc2d73bd.text:
A female staff member of Public Relations Section 2. 28 years old.
As the oldest woman on the section staff, her dependable personality makes her a good big-sister figure who keeps everyone together.
She is often seen fussing over the reckless Akagi, but deep down she thinks of him as someone special.

library.pt_200:r_89f80a355f5724c5.text:
A female staff member of Public Relations Section 2. 20 years old.
She excels at analyzing information and stays calm and collected no matter the situation, without so much as changing expression.
Yet she sometimes cracks jokes as if she were a completely different person, giving her an elusive, hard-to-pin-down personality.

library.pt_200:r_038ef8d709aa84a8.text:
A female staff member of Public Relations Section 2. 20 years old.
She loves gossip and talks a lot, which can make her seem flaky, but she is quick-witted and knows when to buckle down, making her quite reliable at heart.
Information she gets from a certain 'Ayumi in the Secretarial Section' is always at the center of her conversation.

library.pt_200:r_72e06ef95f3afad5.text:
A female staff member of Public Relations Section 2. 25 years old.
True to her youthful looks, she has a childish side, but her mind works quickly, and she handles accounting within the section.
She has a gullible personality, and $$入江$$ often tricks and teases her.
She seems to be inexperienced in romance, and though she is aware of her feelings for $$青山$$, she found it hard to act on them, but as they spent time together she gradually closed the distance between them.
Later, when $$青山$$ was screening candidates for a campaign girl, she surprised those around her by openly showing her jealousy and snatching the file away from him.

library.pt_200:r_e416d0b440e422d4.text:
Section chief of Public Relations Section 2. 48 years old.
A middle manager who spends his days with a knotted stomach over the actions of the $$ダイ・ガード$$ pilots, Akagi chief among them. But he is also the one who understands them best, and he somehow manages to deflect the pressure that comes from both the military and the company's executives.
Normally he plays the part of an unremarkable middle-aged man, but he is actually quite sharp. He was formerly a lieutenant in the $$ＵＮ$$ Volunteer Army, the predecessor of the Security Force, and served as a direct subordinate of then-Colonel $$大河内$$. From those days to the present, $$大河内$$'s trust in him has remained extremely deep.
The reason $$大河内$$ has deliberately kept such a trusted subordinate at the rank of section chief rather than promoting him to executive is simply that the position is a vital link between the field and the president.

library.pt_200:r_d2f39158f1659778.text:
Assistant section chief of Public Relations Section 2. 30 years old.
A hard worker who handles not only his main job of PR planning but also a wide range of tasks, from $$ダイ・ガード$$ maintenance to piloting transport aircraft and leading operations on the front line.
His love for his family runs deeper than most, and he dotes especially on his beloved daughter Mai, always carrying her photo with him.

library.pt_200:r_2c45e7c0b5e45423.text:
In charge of clerical work for Public Relations Section 2. 27 years old.
During $$ダイ・ガード$$'s battles she stays behind at headquarters to provide backup, the unsung pillar of support behind the scenes.
She also acts as the de facto leader who keeps her fellow new hires $$伊集院$$ and $$田口$$ in line.

library.pt_200:r_f6dc0f72286776ee.text:
In charge of planning and production for Public Relations Section 2. 27 years old.
He is the same age as $$石塚$$ and $$伊集院$$, who joined the company in the same year, and he is often seen acting together with them.

library.pt_200:r_161d39e726f9eb53.text:
In charge of domestic and overseas liaison for Public Relations Section 2. 27 years old.
He is known for a speaking style that mixes Japanese and English. He joined the company in the same year as $$石塚$$ and $$田口$$ from the same section.
He seems to have a thing for $$谷川$$, one of the female staff, and made moves on her such as inviting her on a hot spring trip. They did enjoy the trip once, but his wishy-washy attitude ended up angering her, and since then she has refused to have anything to do with him at all.

library.pt_200:r_0af45d9c27318c42.text:
Section chief of the Technical Department at $$２１世紀警備保障$$. 17 years old.
She possesses a genius intellect and is a world-class authority on $$ヘテロダイン$$ research. Since childhood she had understood everything so easily that she came to see the world as boring. But the fact that Heterodynes were something she knew nothing about became a major draw for her interest, and she has arrived at her present position out of a desire to unravel the mystery.
She discovered the Fractal Knot, the foundation that makes up a $$ヘテロダイン$$ and had long been shrouded in mystery, and has gone on to design and devise a series of new weapons and related equipment for $$ダイ・ガード$$.
Her shortcomings are a lack of common social sense and a severe insensitivity to other people's feelings.
When she developed the new weapon Knot Buster, she had not even signed a provisional contract with the subcontracting company, and as a result it ended up being seized by the military.
She also once destabilized $$いぶき$$'s mental state by pointing out that $$いぶき$$'s real father, $$桜田栄二郎$$, had researched the $$ヘテロダイン$$ merely to satisfy his own intellectual curiosity.

library.pt_200:r_b9d802b53fd12907.text:
Chief of the $$ダイ・ガード$$ maintenance crew at $$２１世紀警備保障$$.
He gets along well with Akagi, with whom he shares a certain rapport, and though foul-mouthed, his maintenance skills are the real thing. He constantly worked to bring $$ダイ・ガード$$ back to peak condition after it was damaged in fierce battles with the $$ヘテロダイン$$ or by Akagi's recklessness.
Because he develops equipment for $$ダイ・ガード$$, he has an inseparable relationship with the company's Technical Department, but at first he did not think much of its section chief, $$百目鬼$$. However, after seeing her true face when she happened to trip and fall, he fell for her at first sight, and from then on she often ordered him around, though perhaps out of being smitten he always seemed somehow pleased about it.

library.pt_200:r_83623f414e3c26f9.text:
President of $$２１世紀警備保障$$. 57 years old.
Having personally experienced the terror of a $$ヘテロダイン$$ encounter in the past, he has dedicated his life to protecting people.
He is quiet and tough-looking, but his honest, caring personality has earned him deep trust within the company.
He once belonged to the $$ＵＮ$$ Volunteer Army, the predecessor of the Security Force, and lost his right eye in combat during that time. He still agonizes inwardly over his past decision to use an OE (Over Explosion) weapon against the first $$ヘテロダイン$$ to appear, twelve years ago.
In contrast to the Security Force, which treats $$ヘテロダイン$$ annihilation as the top priority without regard for collateral damage, he has invested his own principles in dealing with them through $$ダイ・ガード$$.

library.pt_200:r_9a3cc5e8e2d13157.text:
Secretary to the president of $$２１世紀警備保障$$.
A capable woman who supports President $$大河内$$ at his side.
She and Akagi are cousins, and they seem to have been close since childhood; it was also she who gave Akagi the push to join the company.

library.pt_200:r_c73120b0774da918.text:
A tactical advisor dispatched to Public Relations Section 2 by the $$ＵＮ$$ Security Force.
He is an expert in operating upright special vehicles, and was dispatched to get the amateurish staff of Public Relations Section 2 to carry out operations swiftly.
He is an extremely serious, rigid stickler who always prioritizes orders and efficiency even in battle, believing that $$ヘテロダイン$$ annihilation came first even at the cost of some sacrifice. Because of this, when he was first dispatched he did not work well with the members of Public Relations Section 2, especially Akagi, who acted from the citizens' point of view.
But as he witnessed Akagi's straightforward sense of justice and sincere actions firsthand, he too began to think about what really needed protecting, rather than pursuing efficiency alone. As a result, being fellow sports types, he and Akagi became a good team.
Beyond his skill at operating upright special vehicles and his tactical eye, he also shows real talent for the piloting technique he picked up while Akagi was injured. Later, when Akagi was absent, he confidently took over as main pilot and succeeded in disabling a $$ヘテロダイン$$.
Incidentally, since $$ダイ・ガード$$ is classified as a special vehicle, $$城田$$'s piloting it without a license technically constitutes driving without one.

library.pt_200:r_a77e6444c7e8f352.text:
An assistant tactical advisor dispatched by the Security Force under the pretense of strengthening cooperation with Public Relations Section 2.
He was apparently the most promising talent at the tactical research institute in London, and he has a correspondingly sharp mind.
He idolizes his senior $$城田$$, and took as his own tactical guideline the words $$城田$$ once taught him, that pursuing efficiency is what matters most. But he is also as stubborn and inflexible as $$城田$$ once was, and became someone who kept pushing unreasonable demands from the military and Nishijima onto Public Relations Section 2.
He was bitter about the way $$城田$$ had come to be influenced by Public Relations Section 2's style of fighting to protect something, and worked to disband the section, including trying to have the military select a new $$ダイ・ガード$$ pilot.
But that scheme ended in failure, and he too was moved by the passion of Akagi and the others, coming to be conscious of ways of fighting beyond mere efficiency, and grew to place his trust in them.

library.pt_200:r_fd71c575e3ef69d8.text:
$$いぶき$$'s stepfather.
He remarried $$いぶき$$'s mother after the death of her real father, $$桜田栄二郎$$.
He does not think well of $$いぶき$$ piloting $$ダイ・ガード$$, and nags at her over every little thing. Being a doctor at a major hospital with a university presidential election coming up, $$いぶき$$ assumed he was only thinking of protecting his own reputation, but that was a serious misunderstanding; his nagging came purely from concern for her safety.
He volunteers to treat patients injured by the $$ヘテロダイン$$, among other things, and is a model doctor deeply trusted by his subordinates.

library.pt_200:r_faf14976e0db1b74.text:
The foremost negotiator in Paradigm City, a city that has lost its memory. 25 years old.
A former military police inspector, he is an old acquaintance of Chief $$ダストン$$.
With a humorous, witty way of speaking, he steadily brings negotiations to a close, delivering results beyond his clients' expectations.
He is basically a feminist and a gentleman, but he can also be quick to lose his temper, and against those who refuse to listen and break faith and the rules, he sometimes resorts to force. That said, his principle is never to carry a gun, no matter how dangerous the job he is heading into.
He is a stubborn man who hates bending his own convictions, but he also has a soft-hearted side, such as when $$ドロシー#240$$ asked to keep a cat and he ended up giving in to her wish after all.
He carries the memory to pilot $$ビッグオー$$, and together with $$ビッグオー$$ he stands against great evil. This is not him playing at being a hero of justice, but the result of confronting those who break faith and human decency with his own law. $$ロジャー$$ himself does not know why he possesses the memory that lets him pilot $$ビッグオー$$.
He makes his home in a decaying bank on 72nd Street, Out of Dome. Because $$ロジャー$$ favors black, everyone living in his household is required to wear black clothing. Also, women are the only ones allowed into his house unconditionally.
His hobby is collecting hourglasses, and he sometimes makes them himself.
He values waking up refreshed a great deal, but since he is a poor riser, he has occasionally been woken by $$ドロシー#240$$'s extreme piano playing.
